description: This file defines utilities and classes for handling modular configuration includes, including parsing, resolving paths, security checks, and deep merging of configuration data. It also exports functions to resolve $include directives within configuration objects.

classes.name: IncludeProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing and resolving $include directives in configuration objects, handling path resolution, security checks, circular include detection, and nested include processing.

methods.name: deepMerge
methods.description: Performs a deep merge of two objects or arrays, concatenating arrays and merging objects recursively.

methods.name: resolveConfigIncludes
methods.description: Main function to resolve all $include directives within a configuration object, given the path and optional custom resolver.
